title: Black Vinyl Gloves, Food Grade Gloves Disposable Latex Free & Powder Free, Guantes for Cleaning Cooking Food Prep

reviews.title: Comfortable Gloves for Everyday Use
reviews.body: I picked up the SWIFTLITE black vinyl gloves for general use around the house and for light cleaning tasks, and they’ve been a solid choice so far. They’re easy to slip on and off, and I like that they don’t have that strong rubber smell some gloves come with.The fit is pretty comfortable—not too tight, but snug enough to still have decent control when handling small items. I’ve used them for cleaning, handling food prep, and even some quick DIY tasks, and they’ve held up well without tearing easily.They’re also nice if you’re sensitive to latex, since these are vinyl and don’t cause any irritation. The black color is a plus too—it hides stains and just looks a bit more professional compared to standard clear gloves.One thing to keep in mind is that they’re not super heavy-duty, so I wouldn’t rely on them for tougher jobs or anything sharp. But for everyday tasks, they do exactly what you need.Overall, these are reliable, no-fuss gloves that are great to have on hand. Good value and practical for a wide range of uses.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on March 30, 2026

reviews.title: they serve their purpose
reviews.body: initially i had problems with these tearing while putting them on.  i was used to nitrile gloves.  these won't just stretch on. i did measure my hand size and bought the proper size fortunately and  i've found that if you just take a second a put your hand in them like you were putting on something expensive lol they go on just fine and work for the purpose they were intended.  you get a lot of gloves for the price. i will be buying them again.note to seller:  thanks, but i won't be needing my money back

reviews.title: Durable, great quality, good price
reviews.body: They are thin, but durable. Great qaulity for the price. We primarily use them to prep food and cook/grill. I buy a size large so everyone in our family can wear them. Size large is too big for me, but it get the job done/does not slide off). It is a snug fit for my husband and son (no tearing).

reviews.title: Long lasting gloves for everyday kitchen use.
reviews.body: My mother uses these to wash dishes.  She says they protect her hand and are very tough.  They can be used multiple times.  She especially likes that she can put her hands in the hot water and not be burned.  She says they fit perfectly and her hand easily slides in and out of them.  They do have a slight odor if you put them close for smelling, but if just using them, you do not smell them.  She says they appear to be made with great quality.  Great value for the money.

reviews.author: Khaleesi

reviews.title: Durable, comfortable, and completely powder-free! Great for food prep and cleaning.
reviews.body: These black vinyl gloves are an excellent addition to both the kitchen and general household tasks. The material is strong enough to resist tears during light scrubbing or food prep, and the powder-free, latex-free design means zero annoying residue or allergy concerns. They slip on comfortably, offer a solid grip, and the sleek black color looks clean and professional. Highly recommend for handling raw ingredients, cleaning, or messy tasks!

reviews.title: Durable and good quality gloves
reviews.body: After Covid outbreak and having a very weak immune system, I have to be precautionary because I certainly don’t want to end up with Covid again.  For someone that never left the house after Covid outbreak I honestly don’t know how I ended up with it twice.  What was extremely frustrating is that the medication they prescribed back in those days if taken could have caused some serious damages.  So from 2020 to present I wear gloves to stay safe, and these gloves are absolutely perfect.  They are made surprisingly well, very durable and feel great.  I actually have purchased more of these when I go shopping I am fully protected.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on July 15, 2026
